resources.title: NumPy beginner's guide
resources.why: Practice arrays, indexing, broadcasting, and numerical operations before implementing image pipelines.

resources.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning
resources.why: Connect linear algebra, probability, and optimization to the mathematics used in vision models.

resources.title: Computer Vision: Algorithms and Applications
resources.why: Build the geometry and image-formation intuition that remains useful alongside learned models.
resources.caveat: Second-edition PDF requires an information form and is for personal use; link to the book page rather than reposting it.

resources.title: Dive into Deep Learning
resources.why: Work through executable explanations of optimization, convolution, attention, and training systems.

resources.title: Understanding Deep Learning
resources.why: Use diagrams and exercises to connect neural-network mathematics with practical modeling decisions.

resources.title: Stanford CS231n
resources.why: Study visual recognition through structured lectures and substantial implementation assignments.
resources.caveat: Public materials are available; enrollment and assignment infrastructure are separate.

resources.title: Stanford CS231A
resources.why: Learn camera models, epipolar geometry, reconstruction, and visual recognition prerequisites.
resources.caveat: Check the course offering for which lectures and assignments are publicly accessible.

resources.title: Practical Deep Learning for Coders
resources.why: Train useful models early, then study the mechanisms behind the training loop.
resources.caveat: Hosted notebooks or GPU services may impose quotas or charges.

resources.title: PyTorch Tutorials
resources.why: Follow maintained examples for tensor operations, transfer learning, profiling, and model export.
resources.caveat: Choose examples matching your installed PyTorch release.

resources.title: Hugging Face Community Computer Vision Course
resources.why: Explore modern vision tasks with model libraries and guided exercises.
resources.caveat: Some exercises need a model download, account, or GPU.

resources.title: MIT Introduction to Deep Learning
resources.why: Use a compact lecture-and-lab sequence to establish neural-network fundamentals.
resources.caveat: Inspect the year of each lab and its runtime dependencies.

resources.title: Full Stack Deep Learning
resources.why: Learn experiment design, data management, deployment, and the engineering around a trained model.
resources.caveat: The 2022 course is selected for durable systems principles, not current package versions.

resources.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
resources.why: Understand residual connections and why deeper networks need careful optimization comparisons.

resources.title: U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation
resources.why: Trace encoder-decoder shapes and skip connections in a practical dense-prediction architecture.

resources.title: Faster R-CNN
resources.why: Separate proposal generation, classification, and box regression in two-stage detection.

resources.title: You Only Look Once: Unified, Real-Time Object Detection
resources.why: Study the original single-stage formulation and its localization tradeoffs.
resources.caveat: The original paper does not describe modern packages that share the YOLO name.

resources.title: End-to-End Object Detection with Transformers
resources.why: Understand object queries, bipartite matching, and detection as set prediction.

resources.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words
resources.why: Connect image patches, positional embeddings, and transformer scaling to visual recognition.

resources.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
resources.why: Learn image-text contrastive training and examine sensitivity to prompts and distribution shift.
resources.caveat: Original training data is not fully released for exact reproduction.

resources.title: A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations
resources.why: Study how augmentation, projection heads, and negatives shape contrastive representations.

resources.title: Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners
resources.why: Investigate masking ratios and asymmetric encoders as a self-supervised learning design.

resources.title: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
resources.why: Derive ray sampling and volume rendering before trying faster reconstruction systems.

resources.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
resources.why: Compare explicit Gaussian scene representations with neural radiance fields.
resources.caveat: Paper availability does not imply unrestricted rights to associated code or datasets.

resources.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
resources.why: Work through the forward noise process, reverse denoising objective, and sampling cost.

resources.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
resources.why: Understand the compute tradeoff of diffusion in a learned latent representation.
resources.caveat: Read each associated checkpoint's separate usage terms.

resources.title: DINOv3
resources.why: Study dense feature quality and transfer beyond image-level classification.
resources.caveat: Full pretraining data and compute are not accessible reproduction defaults.

resources.title: SAM 3: Segment Anything with Concepts
resources.why: Examine concept prompts and the interaction between image detection and video tracking.

resources.title: V-JEPA 2.1: Unlocking Dense Features in Video Self-Supervised Learning
resources.why: Study dense predictive objectives and intermediate-layer supervision for temporally consistent representations.
resources.caveat: Reported benchmark outcomes are task-specific and require the matching evaluation protocol.

resources.title: VGGT-Omega
resources.why: Examine register attention and scalable geometric representation learning.
resources.caveat: Use the authors' September 2026 reproduction checkpoint for benchmark comparisons.

resources.title: Qwen3-VL-Embedding and Qwen3-VL-Reranker
resources.why: Separate multimodal candidate retrieval from cross-encoder reranking and measure both stages.
resources.caveat: Check benchmark versions and checkpoint sizes before comparing reported scores.

resources.title: Torchvision
resources.why: Start with reference datasets, transformations, and pretrained vision models in one ecosystem.
resources.caveat: Check individual pretrained weight metadata and dataset terms.

resources.title: PyTorch Image Models
resources.why: Compare pretrained backbones with consistent model creation and training utilities.
resources.caveat: Pretrained weights can have terms different from the library license.

resources.title: Ultralytics
resources.why: Build a complete detection baseline with training, validation, prediction, and export workflows.
resources.caveat: Review AGPL-3.0 and commercial licensing before using it in a product.

resources.title: RT-DETR
resources.why: Explore transformer detection with an explicit accuracy-versus-latency evaluation target.
resources.caveat: Benchmark on your target hardware with identical preprocessing and batch size.

resources.title: Grounding DINO
resources.why: Use text-conditioned boxes to prototype open-vocabulary detection and annotation assistance.
resources.caveat: Prompted detections require validation; generated labels are not ground truth.

resources.title: Segment Anything 2
resources.why: Learn promptable image and video segmentation with released checkpoints and examples.
resources.caveat: Choose checkpoints and code versions together; video memory use grows with workload.

resources.title: Segment Anything 3 and 3.1
resources.why: Explore concept segmentation and the 2026 shared-memory multi-object tracking update.
resources.caveat: Check the SAM license, gated checkpoint access, and documented CUDA requirements.

resources.title: DINOv3 reference implementation
resources.why: Extract dense features and compare frozen probes with downstream adaptation.
resources.caveat: Weights require access; the custom DINOv3 license and large training budgets need review.

resources.title: CoTracker
resources.why: Track points jointly to study motion, occlusion, and temporal correspondence.
resources.caveat: Code and pretrained checkpoints may have different license terms.

resources.title: ByteTrack
resources.why: Build a tracking baseline that associates high- and low-confidence detections.
resources.caveat: Tracking quality depends strongly on detector, thresholds, and dataset protocol.

resources.title: MMPose
resources.why: Explore pose estimation models, datasets, and evaluation across multiple keypoint settings.
resources.caveat: Check dependency compatibility and each model's data and weight licenses.

resources.title: Qwen3-VL
resources.why: Compare multimodal inference and fine-tuning across model sizes and input budgets.
resources.caveat: Memory and latency depend on image resolution, video frames, tokens, and checkpoint size.

resources.title: Qwen3-VL-Embedding and Reranker code
resources.why: Build visual-document or video search with separate embedding and reranking stages.
resources.caveat: Measure candidate recall before attributing gains to reranking.

resources.title: PaddleOCR
resources.why: Compare scene text recognition, layout parsing, and document VLM workflows.
resources.caveat: Pin pipeline and model versions; language coverage and output schemas vary by model.

resources.title: VGGT
resources.why: Infer cameras, depth, point maps, and tracks from one or more views.
resources.caveat: Original weights are non-commercial; a separately gated commercial-use checkpoint has different terms.

resources.title: Depth Anything 3
resources.why: Explore monocular and multiview geometry through a shared depth-ray representation.
resources.caveat: Check the license of the chosen checkpoint and memory requirements for long sequences.

resources.title: SAM 3D Objects
resources.why: Investigate single-image object reconstruction and inspect ambiguity in unseen geometry.
resources.caveat: SAM license applies; inspect checkpoint access and GPU requirements before downloading.

resources.title: V-JEPA 2 and 2.1
resources.why: Explore video representations, dense-feature learning, and action-conditioned latent prediction.
resources.caveat: Representation evaluation and robot planning require different checkpoints and protocols.

resources.title: OpenVLA
resources.why: Study how a vision-language backbone is adapted to robot action prediction.
resources.caveat: Simulation results do not establish reliable control on a different robot.

resources.title: Physical Intelligence openpi
resources.why: Explore pi0, pi0-FAST, and pi0.5 inference and adaptation on robot demonstrations.
resources.caveat: Review inherited backbone terms and match action conventions to the chosen embodiment.

resources.title: NVIDIA Isaac GR00T
resources.why: Study the N1.7 multimodal policy, data interface, fine-tuning, and simulation evaluation workflow.
resources.caveat: The documented backbone is gated; fine-tuning and inference have substantial GPU requirements.

resources.title: Wan2.2
resources.why: Explore text-to-video and image-to-video generation with released inference code.
resources.caveat: Generation is GPU-intensive; obtain appropriate rights for inputs and downstream media use.

resources.title: OpenCV documentation
resources.why: Implement filtering, features, calibration, geometric transforms, and camera pipelines.

resources.title: scikit-image
resources.why: Build interpretable image-processing baselines and inspect region-level measurements.

resources.title: Kornia
resources.why: Use differentiable image operations and geometry inside PyTorch pipelines.
resources.caveat: Match optional acceleration components to your runtime environment.

resources.title: AlbumentationsX
resources.why: Build synchronized image, box, mask, and keypoint augmentation pipelines.
resources.caveat: Review the current AGPL/commercial licensing terms before adoption.

resources.title: CVAT
resources.why: Create and review image or video annotations with task-specific labeling workflows.
resources.caveat: Self-hosting and hosted plans differ; inspect storage and collaboration requirements.

resources.title: Label Studio
resources.why: Prototype labeling interfaces and organize human review of model predictions.
resources.caveat: Community and hosted or enterprise features differ.

resources.title: FiftyOne
resources.why: Inspect datasets visually, compare predictions, and curate difficult evaluation slices.
resources.caveat: Distinguish open-source functionality from commercial services.

resources.title: DVC
resources.why: Version dataset references and connect experiments to reproducible data pipelines.
resources.caveat: Remote storage incurs its own access controls and storage costs.

resources.title: MLflow
resources.why: Record parameters, artifacts, and model versions for comparable experiments.
resources.caveat: Configure storage and access controls when hosting a shared tracking server.

resources.title: Hugging Face Diffusers
resources.why: Experiment with diffusion pipelines, schedulers, adaptation, and memory controls.
resources.caveat: Library licensing does not replace individual model-card terms.

resources.title: LeRobot
resources.why: Explore robot datasets, policy training, evaluation, and supported hardware interfaces.
resources.caveat: Robot hardware, embodiment compatibility, and dataset terms require separate checks.

resources.title: COLMAP
resources.why: Establish a structure-from-motion and multiview-stereo baseline for reconstruction experiments.
resources.caveat: Difficult texture, repeated patterns, and camera motion affect reconstruction reliability.

resources.title: Open3D
resources.why: Inspect, register, and process point clouds and meshes with reusable geometry tools.

resources.title: COCO API
resources.why: Use the reference evaluator to understand detection and segmentation precision-recall conventions.
resources.caveat: Record category mapping, area ranges, and maximum detections alongside results.

resources.title: TorchMetrics
resources.why: Use tested metric implementations while checking task definitions and aggregation behavior.
resources.caveat: Metric defaults and distributed aggregation can change the meaning of a reported score.

resources.title: LMMs-Eval
resources.why: Run multimodal evaluation with explicit model, task, and prompt configurations.
resources.caveat: Some tasks require licensed datasets, credentials, external judges, or paid APIs.

resources.title: MMMU
resources.why: Examine multidisciplinary visual reasoning and per-domain failure modes.
resources.caveat: Use the correct split and avoid tuning on held-out benchmark answers.

resources.title: MathVista
resources.why: Audit visual mathematical reasoning and distinguish perception errors from reasoning errors.
resources.caveat: Record answer extraction, prompt, and evaluator configuration.

resources.title: WILDS
resources.why: Evaluate generalization across domains with explicitly defined distribution shifts.
resources.caveat: Individual datasets have separate download and use requirements.

resources.title: OmniDocBench
resources.why: Measure document parsing components and reading order using a versioned benchmark.
resources.caveat: Scores from different benchmark versions or matching rules are not directly comparable.

resources.title: ONNX Runtime
resources.why: Export and benchmark model inference across supported execution providers.
resources.caveat: Confirm operator support and numerical parity for your exported graph.

resources.title: OpenVINO
resources.why: Explore conversion, quantization, and inference on supported Intel hardware.
resources.caveat: Hardware support and quantization behavior depend on the selected runtime version.

resources.title: NVIDIA TensorRT
resources.why: Optimize compatible GPU inference while profiling latency, precision, and memory.
resources.caveat: NVIDIA hardware and version compatibility constrain engine portability.

resources.title: ExecuTorch
resources.why: Investigate exporting and running PyTorch models on mobile and embedded targets.
resources.caveat: Operator and backend support vary by target device.

resources.title: Triton Inference Server
resources.why: Study model serving, batching, concurrency, and end-to-end inference observability.
resources.caveat: Server throughput is not equivalent to single-request end-to-end latency.

resources.title: CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100
resources.why: Use small images to practice splitting, optimization, and controlled baseline comparisons.
resources.caveat: Low resolution limits conclusions about real-world visual recognition.

resources.title: Oxford-IIIT Pet Dataset
resources.why: Practice transfer learning and segmentation on a manageable labeled dataset.
resources.caveat: Check the dataset's research-use and image-rights notes before redistribution.

resources.title: COCO
resources.why: Learn standard annotation formats and compare object-level vision pipelines.
resources.caveat: Annotations and source images have different licenses; check individual image rights.

resources.title: PASCAL VOC
resources.why: Use a historically important benchmark to learn detection and segmentation evaluation.
resources.caveat: Specify the challenge year, split, and metric variant.

resources.title: Open Images
resources.why: Explore large-scale, multilabel image annotation and object localization.
resources.caveat: Check image-level licenses, attribution, and available image URLs.

resources.title: ImageNet
resources.why: Understand the benchmark behind many pretrained classification backbones.
resources.caveat: Image access requires registration and compliance with the dataset's terms.

resources.title: KITTI Vision Benchmark Suite
resources.why: Study stereo, optical flow, detection, and odometry with structured driving benchmarks.
resources.caveat: Observe non-commercial terms and task-specific download or submission requirements.

resources.title: nuScenes
resources.why: Explore camera, lidar, and radar perception with a documented autonomous-driving dataset.
resources.caveat: Check the applicable non-commercial dataset license and access agreement.

resources.title: Ego4D
resources.why: Study first-person temporal understanding and action-oriented benchmarks.
resources.caveat: A signed data agreement and substantial storage may be required.

resources.title: MVTec Anomaly Detection
resources.why: Evaluate defect localization with normal training examples and annotated anomalies.
resources.caveat: Review the dataset's non-commercial license before industrial product use.

resources.title: DocVQA
resources.why: Test question answering over document images and inspect text-extraction dependencies.
resources.caveat: Individual tasks and challenge downloads have their own access terms.

resources.title: DROID
resources.why: Inspect diverse robot manipulation demonstrations and cross-environment data variation.
resources.caveat: Full downloads are large; check dataset terms and calibration/action conventions.

resources.title: MedMNIST
resources.why: Practice small-scale medical image classification with standardized tasks and baselines.
resources.caveat: Educational benchmarking does not validate a model for clinical decisions.

resources.title: DOTA
resources.why: Learn oriented object detection and the challenges of large aerial images.
resources.caveat: Specify dataset version, tiling protocol, and dataset usage terms.

resources.title: CVF Open Access
resources.why: Find official conference papers and supplemental material from major computer vision venues.
resources.caveat: Conference inclusion is evidence of publication, not proof that every reported claim generalizes.

resources.title: arXiv Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition
resources.why: Track new preprints, then verify methods, artifacts, revisions, and evaluation details.
resources.caveat: Preprints may not be peer reviewed; check submission and revision dates.

resources.title: PyTorch Forums
resources.why: Search implementation questions and learn to produce minimal reproducible bug reports.
resources.caveat: Community replies require validation against current documentation and your environment.
